title_seed: 先把 Study Facts 變成可拒絕的資料
central_problem: 缺失、未報告、未知與不適用，能不能安全地視為同一種空值？
reader_takeaway: study facts 必須保留 status、locator 與 provenance，尤其要拒絕把 UNKNOWN 變成零。

known_at_the_time.fact: Study Fact extraction V2 分開報告 frozen replay 與 fresh ten-topic extraction。
current-live benchmark reached 7/10 LIMITED and 0/10 FORMAL; Writer requests remained 0。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: current worktree extraction code distinguishes PRESENT、NOT_REPORTED、UNKNOWN、NOT_APPLICABLE and preserves exact provenance。

not_yet_available.fact: 7/10 LIMITED is not 7/10 FORMAL, and replay numeric provenance cannot be promoted to current-live content acceptance。

observed_failures.symptom: fresh extraction did not clear the 10/10 LIMITED and 8/10 FORMAL thresholds
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: some cases lacked direct study admission or had unclassifiable/source-unreported fields; false full-text labels also remained in replay
observed_failures.later_resolution: evidence-gap acquisition and canonical admission moved the boundary further upstream

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: The fresh ten-topic Study Facts V2 run reached 7/10 LIMITED and 0/10 FORMAL, with Writer at zero.
tests_and_metrics.result: study-fact extraction improved classification but did not establish formal publication

engineering_decisions.decision: 把 absence semantics 做成 typed status，對每個 fact 保留 exact provenance，不以推測填值。

architecture_state.state: full-text/abstract material → structured study facts/status → admission → Writer

safe_public_facts.fact: 未知不是零，未報告也不是沒有發生；資料結構要保留這三者的差異。

retrospective_notes.note: 後來 canonical admission 把 Study Fact readiness 納入單一 owner，但本日仍聚焦在 fact status contract。

source_refs.why_it_supports_this_fact: fresh versus replay metrics and Writer closure

publication_risks: 0/10 FORMAL 不能寫成 0/10 有效研究。
replay 與 live 必須分段說明。
